_comment: Per-region category overrides for server-inserted regions found by the DAI oracle. Boundaries stay exact (construction); only the category/ambiguity is a reading of the region's whisper transcript. Keyed by episode id, matched on the region start time (seconds, 3 decimals).

ldn491.note: server-inserted house promo: 'Die Lage geht wieder auf Tour', live-show tickets at lage.live. Inserted like an ad, but for the show itself; whether to cut it is a policy call, so it is a don't-care region.

ldn490.note: server-inserted house promo (same 'Lage auf Tour' spot as in LdN491); don't-care region.
